tools.name: liquid_schema
tools.description: JSON Schema of recipes and layer patches, and the guide.

tools.name: liquid_validate
tools.description: Check a recipe without opening it; returns ok or the list of issues with their paths.

tools.name: liquid_open
tools.description: Turn a recipe into a link that opens the icon in Liquid Composer. The link carries the recipe in its URL fragment, so opening it does not send the recipe to a server. Images must be inline SVG markup or data: URLs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: liquid_validate, liquid_open · Public sink: liquid_open.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: liquid_validate, liquid_open · Public sink: liquid_open

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
